summary: The source constructs the distributed row bounds and local CSR data; the timed loop issues one kernel launch per requested iteration. The kernel assigns output rows across the launch and its CSR loop advances from the row start to row end, accumulating value-vector products and storing each local row. The host dump confirms the measured loop/call sequence and synchronization before the end clock. Final device SASS has the same row guard, nonzero loop, accumulation, and output path.
